name: recombine
description: Recombine selected individuals into a new generation of variants

form_config.name: parents
form_config.label: Parent Individuals
form_config.description: The individuals to breed from. Each offspring comes from its own pair of parents, chosen by the Selection Strategy. A single parent works too: it is paired with itself, so its offspring differ from it only by mutation.

form_config.name: offspring_size
form_config.label: Offspring Count (N)
form_config.description: How many new individuals to breed. Each offspring comes from a separate pairing, so a larger count tries more combinations of parents. An offspring identical to an individual already in the graph is discarded, so you can get fewer than N when crossover and mutation change little.

form_config.name: crossover_type
form_config.label: Recombination Strategy
form_config.description: How each pair of parents is mixed into an offspring.

conditionalProps.description: Greyed out at Crossover Probability 0: no pair is crossed over, so every offspring is a mutated copy of one parent and the strategy has nothing to do.

options.label: Two-Point
options.description: Treats a genome's weights as one long sequence, cuts both parents at two points and swaps the middle piece. A cut can fall inside a layer.

options.label: One-Point
options.description: Treats a genome's weights as one long sequence, cuts both parents at one point and joins the start of one to the end of the other. The cut can fall inside a layer.

options.label: Layer Splicing
options.description: Inherits each layer whole, from one parent or the other, with a single cut between layers, so no layer is split.

options.label: Uniform Swap
options.description: Takes each weight from either parent at random, so the parents are mixed finely within every layer.

options.label: Weight Average
options.description: Takes the midpoint of the two parents, layer by layer. Each layer's two LoRA factors are averaged separately, so the result is not exactly the average of the parents' changes.

form_config.name: selection_type
form_config.label: Selection Strategy
form_config.description: How parents are picked for each pairing.

options.label: Tournament (Fitness-Biased)
options.description: Each parent is the fittest of a few individuals drawn at random (Tournament Size), so higher-scored parents breed more often. Only the order of the scores matters, not the gaps between them.

options.label: Uniform Random
options.description: Every parent has the same chance, whatever its score, which keeps the next generation more varied. Tournament Size and Default Fitness are greyed out.

form_config.name: tournament_size
form_config.label: Tournament Size
form_config.description: Tournament selection only. Each parent is the fittest of this many individuals drawn at random, so larger tournaments favor the top scorers more strongly. Only the order of fitness scores matters, not how far apart they are. Capped at the number of parents.

form_config.name: default_fitness
form_config.label: Default / Null Fitness Override
form_config.description: Fitness assumed for parents you haven't scored. Only Tournament selection uses fitness, and only rank matters: a tournament always picks its highest scorer, so a 100 beats a 2 no more often than a 3 does. This value just sets where unscored parents rank; at 0 they rank below every positive score.

form_config.name: crossover_prob
form_config.label: Crossover Probability
form_config.description: Chance that a pair of parents is actually crossed over. Otherwise the offspring is a copy of one parent, changed only by mutation. At 1.0 every offspring mixes two parents; lower values keep more offspring close to a single parent.

form_config.name: mutation_rate
form_config.label: Mutation Rate (fraction of layers perturbed)
form_config.description: Chance that each layer of an offspring gets noise added. The unit is a whole layer, not a single weight: at 0.01 a genome with 200 layers has about 2 perturbed layers per offspring, and a small genome will often have none. Strength is set separately below.

form_config.name: noise_scale
form_config.label: Mutation Strength (σ, in units of each layer's natural scale)
form_config.description: How much each perturbed layer changes. Gaussian noise with standard deviation σ is added in units of the layer's natural weight scale, which is set from the layer's width, so the same σ moves wide and narrow layers comparably. A fresh layer's weights are about 0.6 in these units, so 0.05 is a small step.

conditionalProps.description: Greyed out at Mutation Rate 0: no layer is perturbed, so the strength has nothing to scale.

form_config.name: active_flips
form_config.label: Expected On/Off Toggles per Offspring
form_config.description: Average number of layers per offspring whose on/off state is toggled. Each toggle switches one layer from its parent's state, on to off or off to on. Whether a switched-off layer keeps changing is set by Freeze Switched-Off Layers.

form_config.name: freeze_inactive
form_config.label: Freeze Switched-Off Layers
form_config.description: When on, a layer that is switched off gets no noise, so switching it back on restores exactly the weights it was selected with. When off, switched-off layers keep drifting unheard, and come back changed.

form_config.name: generate_exemplars
form_config.label: Auto-Generate Exemplars
form_config.description: When on, each offspring gets an exemplar as soon as it is bred, using the settings of the first parent's exemplar (prompt, random seed and so on), so you can compare offspring like for like. When off, offspring have no exemplar until you make one with Generate Exemplar.
